column4: One down, 2041 to go. ;).
Two lines.
One + two = three.
FOUR year-olds often put their FOOT (human legs) in their MOUTH - but they are too young to realize.
三 + two vertical lines = 5.
Indicating 6 parts of the human body: head, body, 2 arms, 2 legs.
This kanji is our good old seven, turned upside down.
Hachi (eight) begins with the sound of the katakana "ha", and it´s approximately the same character.
Kinda of looks like the kanji of 1　一 with the kanji of 8 八added. So think of it as 　一＋八＝九.
Two needles crossing marks the spot, or you can use the Roman character for ten (rotated 45 degrees).
Looks like a huge open mouth.
Open the window, new day.
A month is longer than a day.
A rice field divided into four parts.
There are 3 sections. Imagine the outer two being the whites of your eye. The middle is the pupil. Fill it in with imaginary color.
Tombstone and cross on an old man´s grave.
I have 5 senses.
Don´t look at the sun directly with your eyes, it´s risky!
My companion and I are like two moons side by side.
The sun makes the moon bright.
Someone chanting with their mouth open for two consecutive days.
A diamond sparkles as brightly as three suns.
Three boxes of goods are devoured by the hungry mouths of waiting consumers.
Spine connects head and body.
If you work from Sun UP to Sun DOWN you will be prosperous.
The sun up is early, well before ten.
9am carries with it the rising sun.
3 tens = generation.
The rice field is harvested once a month to get food for our stomach.
A nightbreak happens when the sun rises over the horizon (floor).
The moon has a lot of gall sticking around after sunrise.
The sun spans from horizon to horizon in a day.
The letter "U" is concavely written.
When I get vexed, I give people the middle finger.
Age 18 = olden times.
Faced with his clone, our hero valiantly cut a mark on his forehead right above his eye so that his comrades could tell his true oneself from the enemy.
A white ray is a drop of sun.
100 turned sideways. {sort of the same as what ashoksaraf said}.
Pocky goes in the mouth.
It takes many drops of ten to get to a thousand.
What is in a mouth that permits it to speak a thousand things? Yes, a tongue.
It is a thousand or ten? I need my measuring box.

This kanji does not mean "get up" or "awake." It means rising, like the rising of a salary, or a promotion. STORY: You know that your salary has RISEN UP when your MEASURING BOX has enough dollar bills in it to reach the SUN.
Nine plus a drop rounds it off to ten!
The decimal system uses drops of ten as a measurement.
Sometimes I get carried away and do elbow curls until the point where my forearm snaps off! When that happens I simply pull out the glue and re-attach the elbow to my flesh.
After you have chosen your 10 fields of study, measure how good you are at each to find out your specialty.
Ten specialties grants you the title of Dr. with a dot.
Fortune-telling: using a mouth as a divining rod.
A magic wand standing on above the floor.
Roots are below the ground.
The most eminent magician is he who learned to use his magic wand early in life.
There is mist as the moon fades away in the morning.
When I wake up, I am always late, so I hurry to work. With a bad case of perpetual morning breath, I am the subject of derision at my office whenever I open my mouth.
Imagine an animal with only a mouth and legs.
Eye thought I saw a shellfish legging it down the beach!
The new generation of pop songs have no depth. They just mouth empty lyrics to get money. Not like the pop songs of my day.
A magic wand is needed to make a clam stand upright.
An employee (member of the company) has to clam up his mouth if he wants keep the job!

Fortune teller writes your fortune on a piece of paper and tells you to affix it to a shell and throw into the ocean for it to come true. Picture licking the back of the shell like a stamp and affixing it to the fortune.
As a primitive, this is Mike Wazowski from Monsters Inc. (the giant eyeball with legs...) Makes for easy stories later on.
In the olden times, a newborn babe came out legs first.
In the beginning were just two who walked on human legs.
A shellfish carrying a page balanced on its head.
A stubborn person in the beginning gets something into their head and can´t change their mind.
A drop of breeze is naught but a mediocre wind.
Tied up, the shellfish had to accept defeat!
I bound ten thousand dollars together and hid it under the floor.
Some Japanese phrases are difficult to wrap your mouth around.
When you expose your flesh to the wind it gets textured: goosebumps!
Hesig should be BOUND for a DAY (or maybe 10 days - a decameron) for calling this Kanji DECAMERON. See martyrdom (#809).
A ladle binds drops together.
I managed to hit the bull´s eye by throwing my white ladle.
The V shape is your neck on top of your collar bone, or the straight line. Yourself, or the rest of your body is below that!
This is a fish hook, that pulls out the fishguts.
The riot police broke up the riot by dragging the rioters away by their tongues with fishooks.
If you get a needle in your eye that is hooked in there, get to a hospital straightaway.
Keep an eye on your tools while you work at the table.
A compass is a tool with a needle on top that points to true north.
I consider craft to be one of the harder primitives to use in stories so I´ve personified it as Bender the crafty robot from Futurama who was designed to bend I-beams.
The LEFT side of my brain posesses the faculties needed for logical crafts, like engineering.
The right hand is for putting food in your mouth. (The other hand is for ass-wiping!).
Possessed by the Earth´s gravity, the moon stays by its side.
To bribe someone, money is a necessary possession.
This next song is a TRIBUTE to a little SHELLFISH friend of mine who was tragically crushed by an I-shaped table..
To write a paragraph is the craft of grouping sentences on a page.
This SWORD is so sharp, it can cut the top part of カ off in カタナ.
The part of a sword where a drop of blood can usually be found is the blade.
The seven samurai used their swords to cut their opponents.
A man is easily seduced by a mouth to his "sword.".
Shining is the sun´s seduction.
When you have both money and the power of the sword, you can make the rules.
The wealthy guy with the sword standing next to the king, that´s the vice-roy who does all the dirty work.

I don´t know about you but to me this seems like someone´s head is about to be separated from his body. You can see he´s kneeling and his mouth is wide open gasping for the last breath he will ever take.
Today, the program "Sesame Street" is brought to you by the letter "T".
Actually this means town, like one that has lots of streets and is surrounded by all the rice fields.
A mouth on the street asking for things: "Can I get some help?! Can I get directions, Can I have some money? Can you please speak English?!".
If I put a street sign on my head what do I get ? A place on the head !
A child who is ten will still ask for his ma (top looks a bit like katakana ma).
The child´s arms flailed around at the sight of the hooked tool the dentist was going to use to fill his cavity.
The experiment was a complete failure! The child was made without any arms!
To remember the order of strokes, remember a female ninja is called a "kunoichi". That is, く(hiragana) ノ(katakana) 一(kanji, ichi=one).
A woman is fond of her child.
Women share a common likeness. Their mouths are always open, whining about this and that.
The two breasts of a momma who breastfeeds.
Ariel the Little Mermaid´s clamshell bra was held to her breasts by piercings.
My elder brother was basically a mouth on legs when he was a teenager.
Caution: this means a spell, not to swear. I put a curse on my elder brother so that he can never open his mouth.
Ten elder brothers can overcome anything.
A little penguin with its wings at its side.
Only a few people can make an ugly face like that.
A person stretching their arms and legs to look large and scare a bear away.
Two evenings too many!
The evening is young, the moon is not full.
Eventide is just another word for evening, and it has the word tide in it which we associate with water.
A young magician likes to practice outside in the evening with his magic wand (as opposed to the old magician who wakes early to practice with his wand in eminent (#51)).
In the evening, when it becomes dark, open your mouth to say your name so that people can recognise you.
Indiana Jones jumps up and grabs the lip of cliff just in time to evade the huge STONE rolling out of the mouth of the cave!
Using DNA matching, a very little bit of flesh can be used to show the resemblence between family members.
That stone has sparks coming out of it! Someone must have poured nitrate acid on it.
To SMASH a STONE you need to hit it NINE or TEN times.
Here´s how I remember that stone is on the left. This is because sand starts as stones, and only later they become few.
The jealous woman bashed the brains in of the guy who betrayed her, with a stone.
Sparks will fly if you attempt to PLANE your sabre.
A ray of light is not a wave but made of little photons with human legs.
A large person with a big drop of sweat dripping off of him because he is so plump.
Imagine four hungry mouths all sitting around the table. They are all banging their utensils on the table waiting for a big meal to be placed in the centre.
The ST. BERNARD DOG lifted his large NOSE high in the air to find out where the stinking smell comes from.
Your mouth stinks: you need to sniff your breath.
Exquisite women are few and far between.
You focus by concentrating your eye on fewer objects.
In Sparta we throw our Children over a Cliff. Under the Sun, they fight other Children. In the end, if they survive, they sure have thick skin.

I find it strange that so many people commit suicide in Tokyo by throwing themselves in front of the train. To me when I look at this kanji, I see a train just about to come out of a tunnel, and above the man waiting for his oppourtunity where he can end it all.
So as not to confuse this with river (#146) think of streamers falling down.
There were 3 little islands in the stream who all decided to set themselves up as independent states.
Obey, Obey! says the brain-washing scientist as he sends a stream of orders to fill your head.

The kanji for water is an abstract primitive itself, so unless one is willing to break down its etymological development, it should just simply be memorized by strokes; constructing a story is not necessarily useful unless it strongly denotes its shape (I find that Heisig´s story doesn´t do this).
Icicles start with 1 frozen drop of water.
It would take an eternity to count all the drops of water.
White is a symbol of purety, so white water is pure water, the precise definition of spring water.
A body part that acts like a spring for hormones is a gland.
Follow the springs down the cliff and you will find a nice meadow.
Let´s petition to save that beautiful MEADOW from overdevelopment by signing on this PAGE.
With that much WATER (2 actually) you would need to swim for an ETERNITY.
The marshlands near Mordor seduce Frodo into gazing upon them, and he falls into the water--splash!
Open sea is a lot of water in the middle of nowhere.
Yeah, all our water is fairly mediocre, but if we work together in some pan-continental union, we can make some better water! As if.
A CREEK is a small trail of water easily crafted with a stick.

I couldn´t find any reference to this kanji as meaning cleanse. It seems to be most often used in the following compound 沙汰（さた）to mean affair. The other meanings seem to be closer to ´select´ so maybe Heisig meant cleanse in the ethnic sense here.. I´m going to use the keyword "selection", as in natural selection. Story: natural selection first began in the water, and those that were too plump were selected out.
To make soup you just take water and add (+) the rest of your ingredients.
Wet sand is simply sand but to see beautiful grains of sand, the water must be few.
The morning tide is basically, well, WATER in the MORNING.
The water that flows from the meadow is the source of life for the wild antelope.
Conversations can become more lively after everyone has had a few drinks. It´s because "watery tongues" loosen lips!
To extinguish a SPARK, you need WATER.
If you ask your teenager if what he´s drinking is water (and not Vodka), he will answer "but of course".
A river CAN exist only if there is WATER.
Please supply a guest who stays overnight with WATER and WHITE sheets.

This is my favorite story. Simply associate the sad moment of an OLD person, standing near the WATER of the lake and looking at the MOON reflected in the lake. The created primitives themselves are put so beautifully, that you will not forget this kanji.
A fathom is the unit you use when making rules about water´s depth.
Remembering soil is easy. If soil is soft, you can take a walking stick and plunge it two* feet into the ground.
The only things that come out of my MOUTH and onto the GROUND are spit and vomit. Everything else (words, song) floats on the air.
The GROUND at the base of a CLIFF must suffer from enormous pressure.
This refers to LAND, not the STRANGE gear superheroes wear.
Before the Great Wall of China, there was a dirt hedge that spanned across.
"In a hole in the ground, the body of the victim was placed. And then the killer stuffed it up so that the truth would not be found out, he hoped."
Piling SOIL upon SOIL for aeons is how SQUARE JEWELS are formed deep in the earth.
The king used a special seal of ivy leaves glued onto his document.

Try to reverse Heisig´s story in this Kanji: imagine being trapped in one of those prison towers on an ivy cladcliff like in the movies. From your prison ontop the ivy clad cliff all you can see in the distant horizon is nothing but water.
At the Buddhist temple the monks are seated on the ground, glued there in meditation.
When the SUN starts to shine on the TEMPLE, it´s time to get up.
Soil is scooped up into a ladel. The extra drop is brushed off to make it level.
For some reason, this kanji reminds me of a person running, her arms (the two drops) raised up, because she caught on fire!
To fight fire with fire would just inflame a situation.
An anxiety feels like FIRE in the HEAD.

Drink water and burn twice as many calories as you eat... you´ll definitely get thin. Imagine inside your body, all those calories literally being burned from above and below... THAT´s what it takes to become thin.
Imagine old gas lamps which had a flame to light up the street signs.
Many farms are created by first setting FIRE over the land to clear the land for the FIELDS.
What a disaster! First a FIRE, then on top of it came FLOODs.
The fire underneath the cliff will eventually turn everything above to ashes.
The FORTUNE TELLER was burned by FLAMES on the spot because she was accused of being a witch.
SHINING FLAMES illuminate!
The elements of this kanji are bound up, rice field and cooking fire. When I think of bound up cooked rice, it makes me think of sushi, which in turn brings to mind fish.
You need WATER and FISH for fishing.
The ri is a Japanese way of measuring the area of the GROUND underneath a RICE FIELD.
If you burn the GROUND of a RICE FIELD with FIRE, eventually it will turn black.
Theres BLACK on the GROUND...most likely someone spilt some black ink.
Japanese carp are massive fish - they are measured in ri!
I did such a quantity of work that when NIGHT BREAK came, I was asleep on the COMPUTER.
I threw my Rindows computer off a cliff because it kept crashing. Now, after its last crash, it´s worth less than a rin.
You can´t bury computers underground, because of the dangerous heavy metals, so you hide them behind an equally large mound of soil and hope no-one notices.
Muslim women wearing veils (HOOD) all look the same, you can just see ONE MOUTH and very little else.
All the animals in the den share the same water.
A trunk, a trunk // The body of a monk // The body of a monk in a trunk, a trunk.
Look over yonder ! That tiny dot is robin hood at the mouth of his secret cave !
An especially esteemed alien has three antennae on his helmet.
CHILDren learn Kanji characters underneath a HOUSE.
A GUARD is usually "glued" to the house he watches.
Make the perfect impression in the beginning by removing your shoes upon entering a Japanese home.
You can proclaim your opinions from the comfort of your HOUSE and have it SPAN the entire globe these days via The Internet.
I burn the CANDLE in my HOUSE until the WEE HOURS reviewing the kanji!!!

It´s funny, Hesig gives no Kanji in his book that means cheap/inexpensive... well... if you were wondering what Kanji would carry that meaning, look no further. Sometimes I wonder if Hesig just thinks our little brains would be too easily confused by multiple meanings. Regardless, think of that woman relaxing. Cheapest place to do that is in one´s own home rather than at some fancy resort, eh? 家で休暇を取るは安いですね。.
The WOMAN spent all DAY preparing a banquet in the HOUSE.
The strange house has a sign saying "DRAW NEAR" in its window, instead of a ´Beware´ sign. It must be a trick!
Remember Ducktales? That rich duck had that room in his house where he kept all the wealth! He had so much in that house you could even swim in it!
It takes a lot more than one clam of savings to buy a house on a street.
If you need a story for a tree, then you need to be hit by one.
A grove has at least two TREEs.
The higher you go up a mountain the less trees there are, that´s so u dont mess up with their possition like i do.

Simple mnemonic : "The Japanese Judas-tree is the tree on which Judas hang himself to the ivy" (Judas the traitor of the Christian bible). Just picture Judas hanging himself, using ivy as a if it was a rope.
The wood from oak trees can be used to make barrels in which white wine is aged. What´s more, I love white wine with an oaky flavour...
wood at 90 (9 * 10) degrees.
At Christmas time, on the treetops, people used to place great big candles (Now we usually place a star instead).
A shelf is a wooden companion to books.
From the tree straight into the mouth is the best way to eat an APRICOT!

In Japan, a paulownia (きり）is known as the "princess tree". It was once a traditional TREE planted at the SAME time as the birth of a daughter. It would grow fast enough that, at the time of her wedding, it could be used to make a dresser as a wedding present for her.
Plants don´t become trees straightaway.
To the Japanese, the first time they saw a chair, it looked like a strange use of wood! Probably why they still like to sit on the floor...
A tree withers away as it gets old.
Wooden wands are the crudest. They are nothng compared to their carbon fibre equivilents.

If you´ve ever played an old 8 bit or 16 bit RPG, like Dragon Warrior or Final Fantasy or Inindou, you´ll remember that every town was all bordered off by a line of trees with no space in between to get out through. Imagine that the trees were glued together so you could only exit town through the main or side gates, (so you couldn´t escape the important scripted scenes.).
The prime minister is having inter-course behind that tree! All you can see are his eyes poking out from the righthand-side of the tree.
My wooden desk is so messy, it looks like a strong wind blew my things all over it.
The origin of a book is paper made out of TREEs. ONE tree can make many books.
Botanists like to identify TREEs by HOOKing tags on them.

Years-Months-Days: It takes many years for a cliff to form or erode. A tree takes many months to grow. But days pass by regularly - so in this way, we see the movement of time such as with a CALENDAR.
I plan to RELAX on top of that TREE.

Tip: goods + wood/tree : This combination of primitives appears four times in Heisig, so it´s worthwhile giving it a name. I suggest "furniture" (a common type of wooden goods). REF: parch (FRAME 215) , maneuver (#671), winding (#1369), seaweed (#2035). Story: It´s been so parched recently that your furniture suddenly catches fire.
I believe a better version of that by mameha1977: [Cheat] Remember these as a set: The tree (木) does not yet (未) have exremities (末) of vermilion (朱).
The tree has reached the extremity of its growth and no longer produces small, new branches at the top. Instead the existing top branch just grows longer and longer.
Something that is obscure has not yet been brought before the light of day.
The extremity of a wave of water is the splash.
My mouth has not yet swallowed the food because the flavor is so delicious that I keep chewing it.
My younger sister is NOT YET a fully grown WOMAN.
It´s autumn: only one vermilion leaf on the tree has not yet fallen.
Which tree would you buy stocks in - the healthy one on the left, or the one with only one vermilion leaf left on the right?
The young little girl held a cute flower in her right hand.
Grass grows in earlier than flowers.
Flowers for the old man suffering in the hospital.
How many flowers can I stuff in your nostrils? Well I´m just gonna have to go and see. Bullying at its worst!
A tolerant person will ignore SEEing GRASS (marijuana) in the HOUSE of a friend.
A Dr. missing his needle can only use dilute flower water for medicine.
On top of the leaves a flower appears, promising new generations for the old tree below.
If I find out this furniture you´re selling me is made of imitation wood, I´ll put you in the graveyard.
The precise locations of sailors who meet a WATERY GRAVE are vague.
The soil under a graveyard is full of graves.
He made a livelihood out of robbing GRAVEYARDS in broad DAYlight.
In the moonlight of the graveyard I hear a zombie say, MMMMM..EMM...BRANEsssss.
If you plant seedlings in a FIELD eventually they will FLOWER.
When your wife´s LEGs get huge hairs on them it is surely a bad portent for things to come.
The pits of a peach tree look like turtles.
Sauron´s One fiery eye stare at Frodo and it is a sign of portent. Evil will become whomever the eye is staring upon.
A large dog, dripping drool.
It was left to the turtle to make right with the dog and thus maintain the status quo..

The computer won´t stop beeping, which is making the chihauhua bark, and it´s driving this guy insane. The only solution he can come up with is to throw them both on the fire and finally enjoy the silence.

Flesh of a dog over a cooking fire = "hotdog". There are all sorts of things in hot dogs. Believe me, you don´t want to know what sort of things . Visualize the hotdog curling as it cooks, to remember the unusual way the flesh primitive curves in this kanji. (tweaked version of ziggr´s. Thanks!).
REEDS are the only FLOWERS that WILD DOGS like to FIRE up and smoke while they are playing poker.
Actually when hunting it may be a good idea to use a pack of dogs as your personal guard.
The cat hid in the FLOWERS of the FIELD from the WILD DOGs.
A cow tried to climb up a vermilion tree, but in doing so, it broke its two bottom branches off.
Think of not special people, but special animals. The sacred Hindu cows are special - they can wander around the temple without fear of becoming roast beef.
The revelation makes the cow´s mouth drop down, "Hamburgers are made of what?!".
I´ve never seen a cow with human legs before!
In Japan, you always wash with water from the shower before you enter the bathtub.
The two strokes at the bottom look like a J and I, which stands for "jammed in.".
One Japanese farmer I know is so small minded that he thinks the entire world is JAMMED IN the borders of his little RICE FIELD.

Some people think drinking tea is boring and quaint. That´s why I spice mine up by adding a cocktail umbrella, which of course is made from a wood-en toothpick supporting a paper umbrella with flowers printed on top.

Look, says the teacher in biology class. "The spinal column holds your flesh together, just like the metal rod of this umbrella (he demonstrates this with an umbrella covered in I-Ching symbols) holds the umbrella together".
I wouldn´t mind a meeting of mouths with her, she´s really fit !
In order to build a pagoda in this small Japanese garden everything has to fit: the soil to the left and the flowers in the upper right corner.
To be king you have to be a real crafty one !
The king is said to have only one family jewel below the belt...
On treasure island is a single house - where all the jewels are stored.
The king of the Oysters produces special Vermillion pearls!
The KING ... can SEE clearly the PRESENT state of affairs in the land. (maybe he hees them in the crystal ball on the left?).
The ball was the only thing that people at the beginning of time had to use as a toy. Poor cavemen.
Oh no ! A pack of dogs has bitten the king. He has turned into a rabid lunatic !
The Sun King (Louis XIV) was known for his effulgent reign.
Ancient Rome had Emperors instead of Kings, and they wore white robes. Thus an emperor is a king in white. (make sure you picture a roman emperor not a japanese one and you´ll be ok).
The mouth of the king is displaying his bling.
The fat king hogs the whole space under his umbrella. (tweaked version of radical tyro´s story. "fat" makes a more vivid image for me.).

The fat king under his umbrella offers useless advice to the workers. "You´ll need the whole tree to plug that gap". Imagine a grossly fat, incompetent king under a parasol giving annoying advice to sweating workers who know what they´re doing. (I always have trouble bringing up the "whole" primitive. This story reminds me how to build that part. ).
The king of LOGIC is the computer.
A lord is a little drop down from King in hierarchy.
Visualize an idiot trying to figure out how to extinguish a candle. He sees a glass of WATER and decides to pour it onto the CANDLESTICK to put it out. Water spills everywhere.
The main pillar in a house should be made of the biggest and strongest tree - the lord of the trees.
The fat king taking up the whole space under the umbrella actually isn´t fat - he just has two big gold bars hidden under his clothes.
Pig iron is basic/crude metal, that is, before it has been processed.
This is the BOWL of an alchemist: see how he mixes metals in his bowl, as he follows the instructions from his book?
I can´t believe no one has used this one yet: Copper is metal which looks almost the same as gold. Really, look it up on Wikipedia, it´s yellow and it´s shiny (atleast in some compounds)!
All the people that go to the Japanese festivals to catch fish part time are suckers. Me? I´m a pro. I bring a big-ass golden ladle. I´m a true ANGLING professional.
Remember the story of the needle in the haystack. Why would someone even look for a needle if it wasn´t a GOLD NEEDLE?
A piece of metal with a name on it. Well, this is basically the definition of inscription.
Tranquilize - using a metal syringe to get the truth.
When we go out on the ROAD-WAY, we often risk our own necks (that´s why I take the train! ).
For guidance on the road-way, glue a GPS unit to your car.
Cross-road.
The car went too swiftly through the crossing and was hooked by the cops.
A cow creates a road by eating all the grass on its path.
When you have the URGE to go to White Castle, you know it´s time to hit the road.
I used my pants to make a rope, which I then used to escape from prison; hence the naked, hairy legs running along the road!
Caution: this kanji doesn´t mean environment; it means "environs; boundary; border; vicinity". To separate the environs, create the border by placing daggers on the road.
The cops don´t PATROL anymore - they just flood the road.
My car is so fast it can go through ten rice fields in ten minutes.
When you put your car on the road you should always take along a few friends. Don´t confuse with carry (#303).
My car got so stuck in a rut it required nine people pushing to get it out again.

The car is a cattle-car, used to transport animals for the butcher´s meeting - a convention on new butchering techniques. Hear the screams of the animals as it pulls up in front of the convention hall, where the butchers are waiting with their knives out front.
When I get horny my flesh sword sticks out in front of me.
In many asian restaurants, meat is roasted right in front of you over flames.
Son, I´ve never told you this but each woman has a second mouth between their fiiiiiine walking legs.
Ranger! I want you to go check the status of each tree. "Errr, Each tree sir?" replies the ranger looking out over the vast forest. "That´s Right, I want the status of each tree! Move out!".
It might sound simple to bribe someone, but then you have to graft the guy above him and the guy below him, and soon you´re just giving shells to each and everyone!
There are so many abbreviations and acronyms nowadays that no brain can remember each of them. Mnemonic: ab-brain-each-ation.
Each person under my roof is treated as a guest.
Sign the guestbook page with your forehead. (Picture a guestbook full of forehead prints like thumbprints).
In SUMMER you are hot from the top of your head down to your walking legs.
The best way to dispose of a nasty bit of wind is to let it go and use those walking legs to dissapear. Nobody will ever know it was you.
They all say they have a TREE between their WALKING LEGS but most only have a TWIG.
Water each flower or the petals will wither and fall.
The king´s crown was blown off by the wind. "Oh well," he said, "it´s just a superfluous symbol.".
The beast of hades one day will wear a crown, and the number of the beast is 666.
British army cars are at the service of the crown.
Rays of light emitted from Apollo´s chariot = radiance. Don´t put the sun into this kanji. The rays are coming from the chariot directly!

Don’t confuse it with “take along” (287). In that one, there was a car so you could take along your friends once you found them on the road. In this one, there is an army chariot just to carry military supplies (sorry no room for you).
Remember the SUPERFLUOUS CROWN that flew away in the WIND? Well now the king is saying "i should have had the thing GLUED to my head from the BEGINNING".
Last night´s date with Miss Sweden was like a dream. She even laid flowers over my eyes to crown the perfect evening.

A magic bow that only Gandalf can yield: there is no bowstring on it, and he uses his magic to fire arrows.

[instead; on the contrary; rather] Gone is the time for stamps - use e-mail instead.

(re: dingomick) "These are your orders," declares the general while passing out documents at the meeting. As everyone started to leave, the general exclaims "Oh wait! I need to certify these orders!" and went around stamping each paper with his personal chop-seal.
The amount of people that can order the rain to rain.

I doubt that the jello would congeal sitting on the counter, so I placed it in the icebox.

Your address should be displayed on your house and mailbox.

Japanese "gardens" aren´t anything more than a pot of flowers on top of the mailbox.
I couldn´t drop my grudge against him. So I put a severed pig´s heart in his mailbox. He got the message.
Having decided to use SIGN OF THE HARE rather than RECEIPT and STAMP my mnemonic goes as follows: The WILLOW is the TREE that droops likes a HARE´s ears.

There´s a buyback program where you can trade in your dagger for money. But it´s quite ineffective, since only registered dagger-owners with the original receipts can participate, and not criminals with illegally-purchased daggers.

To me, this looks like a pictograph of a road leading to the big city (see the buildings?) where there are plenty of places to be entertained. Unfortunately in this city, every store is the same: staples. What tools! [ayoung24].
The sign of the bird on this whiskey bottle is of course the Famous Grouse blended Scotch.

The secrets of fermentation are passed to the son who displays the most filial piety.

Japanese festivals have drums so big, a samurai has to SIT (not stand) on a table to beat one with a tree branch! http://www.d2.dion.ne.jp/~hidafyh/furukawayh/gyouji/image/maturi03.jpg.

Three dishes stacked side-by-side in a dishwasher.

Vampire orders blood in one of those posh restaurants. You are so poor you dont know where your next dish will come from all you know is that you will have to steal it.

The lid of this dish is gone! Now the whole room smells of the flowers that were used in the cooking.

While the slave-buyer is perusing (perusal (#855)) the stack of slaves reclining on the floor, the slaves' overseer supplies them with dishes of gruel -- don't want the slaves starving to death before they can be sold!

The fierce WILD DOG attacked the CHILD who came near his feeding DISH.

Like gold, silver is a metal.

Counting the nodes on bamboo is an instant way to tell its age.

He was pushed to the limit at the end of the marathon, climbing on top of the Acropolis, but had to settle for the silver medal.

With a drop of silver, the forces of good can vanquish the werewolves.
[Image: ´Moonlight sonata´] The moon has inspired many good composers (like Ludwig van Beethoven) to write something melodious.

Your daughter is a good girl......well, let´s hope so... :-).
That umbrella looks good enough to eat!
After I eat a meal, I always have to take an anti-acid.
My experience with Japanese enkais (dinner parties): plenty to drink drink drink, but a severe lack of food, T_T.

All those starving models in Hollywood - they want to eat, but their ego (about their appearance and trim look) makes sure they grin and bear it!

This Bldg. is like all the other government buildings - they house bureaucrats who sit around sipping wine and eating expensive meals at the taxpayers expense.
Call your friend and he answers the phone "Mochi, mochi!" whatever he is eating sure is making it hard to understand. I will puzzle over the content of our conversation for some time to come.
A sheep became the foster parent for a wolf pup, feeding it with milk. This story cannot end well...
My gluttony was only sated after I ate the hamburger AND the wrapper!

Distinguish from formerly (#501). Think of previously as "the previous customer" in a restaurant. At a cheap sleazy diner, the waitress gives you unwashed silverware that was previously used by the previous customer. Yuck.
The police tried to draw a chalk outline around the dead waitress, but it was kinda tough with all the tree roots underneath her.

There´s an even covering of water lilies on the pond at 金閣寺（きんかくじ） the Golden Pavilion in Kyoto.

A SABRE is used to cut the stalks of plants being REAPED at harvest. They are then combined into a SHEAF.

I´ve finally met my arch-rival, the evilest of all villains. Finally, I´m about to fight him. But what´s this? He´s suspiciously quiet. I move to attack him, and his right arm falls off at the elbow. Michael Jackson is the king of pop, wearing his crystal rhinestone glove (see detach (#1492).
X marks the spot on the tree where the missile hit. No doubt, it was meant to kill us.
The St Bernard is bracing itself for an operation requiring four stitches.

For remembering the primitive earthworm: Drops of rain were falling so I took my shovel to dig up some earthworms to put them on my fishook..... My story: To have a genuine fishing line you don't just pick up a stick but you also attach some thread onto it and at the end an earthworm must be hung.

Eating spicy food makes you stand up ten times faster than usual, ´cause you just need to get something to drink!

My rice-seedlings have become sentient and will go on a mission. I can only apologise for the next 6 frames. In the distance, there is a pinnacle, which the newly-awakened rice-seedlings who are still stuck in the ground can see. Could it be the Promised Land?

A greedy hog in a top hat who has eaten all of the acorns. He even elbows people out of the way to get them.
In the nucleus of the acorn, all the DNA is stored -- the building blocks for a new tree.

When I was GROWING UP, the SURFACE of my SCARF was always covered with snot from blowing my nose on it.

This is the first CELL of a human, the foundation of its entire LIFE, a small DROP that will GROW UP to form a complex organism.

You are struggling to the top across the humps, but you suddenly see the pinnacle and you feel new life in your walking legs.

I put my fingers together in worship of the bush that hangs from the ceiling -- that wonderful mistletoe which has gotten me kissed by many a girl.

Japanese father enrolls his student in a well-rounded school: they teach eastern traditions (the way of the bamboo), western traditions (like Christmas trees), and also teach literature (once upon a time).

Learning Kanji is difficult for Turkeys.

Someone wishing from the bottom of their heart that the clock would stop. A mid-life crisis perhaps.

Some jackass-like people have way too much spare time. You can find video´s of them all over the internet, if you like such things, you can watch it all day. You see them stapling their mouths shut, or throwing eachother upside down in boxes or kicking each other in the crotch.

(thx geezer) The maimed waitress (no head and arms just her legs and trunk) is dropped into the water with a cement crown to make sure she sinks. She shouldn´t have been so nosy about her yakuza-boyfriend´s schemes.

Ten rakes woman. your wife digs her fingernails into you and it feels like 10 rakes when she finds you ontop of another woman.

If you thought that the dude in 哀 was pathetic, you haven´t seen him after his decline. Here he is carrying a stick around in his mouth like a dog, begging people to throw it for him. Note that the mouth is closed only after the stick goes in, as is only logical.

This represents a stern looking owl, perched up on a cliff. This cliff is quite famous for daring individuals to cliff dive off of, but is any of them daring enough to threaten the owl?

Primitive: A condor is like a vulture but twice the size and lives in mountainous regions (+1 Elphalpo). Story: I swing my fingers back and forth, trying to fend off the attacking condor.

Magic wand + first two strokes of pelt (皮) + diced + human legs.
